questions.stem: Which statement correctly compares fermentation and hydration of ethene as methods of making ethanol?

options.text: Fermentation uses crude oil as a raw material
Hydration produces a purer product and is a faster, continuous process
Fermentation requires higher temperatures than hydration
Both methods produce impure ethanol that needs distillation

questions.explanation: Hydration of ethene produces pure ethanol in a fast, continuous process, but uses non-renewable ethene from crude oil. Fermentation uses renewable sugar but is a slow batch process producing impure ethanol (maximum 15%) that requires distillation.
